## What the original guide said

::: {.callout-note title="Archived explanation · not independently verified reporting"}
Creates a Department of Water and Wastewater, transferring these functions out of Public Works beginning January 2029. Also removes the charter requirement that Public Works bureaus be created or abolished by ordinance.

**Original recommendation: LEAN NO.** This records Everett’s pre-election position, not the election result. The archive retains the full reasoning.
:::

[Read the ballot guide](../guide/index.qmd#question-h).
